**Who We Are**

The City of Beverly Hills has a long-standing reputation for providing superior customer service to residents, businesses, and visitors. This characteristic, combined with outstanding staff in all departments, has been a hallmark of success for this high-performance organization. The municipal government (approximately 1,000+ full-time and part-time employees) provides the highest quality safety services, recreational activities, municipal services, and physical environment.

jobs.title: Financial Reporting / Record to Report Controllership Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
**Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation**  
  
**Help finance organizations modernize core processes, improve transparency, and drive better business decisions. As part of Deloitte's Finance Transformation practice, you will work with finance leaders to address record-to-report and controllership challenges through practical, technology-enabled solutions. Join a team that helps clients strengthen finance operations and deliver measurable value.**  
  
**Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/27.**  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
**As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth & Transformation on the Finance Transformation Record to Report team, you will be responsible for...**  

* **Assessing current-state controllership processes, identifying gaps, and defining target-state opportunities**
* **Developing transformation roadmaps and solution hypotheses across people, process, technology, and governance**
* **Applying accounting, regulatory, and compliance requirements to finance transformation initiatives**
* **Designing improvements across finance data, cost transparency, financial close and consolidation, and reporting processes**
* **Managing day-to-day client delivery, supporting engagement planning, and contributing to proposals and recruiting efforts**
* **Support Record to Report processes and close activities using platforms such as Workiva and BlackLine, including account reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting workflows**

  
**A successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* **Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team**
* **Effective written and verbal communication skills**
* **Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product**
* **Ability to build and sustain professional relationships**
* **Ability to lead projects or workstreams**
* **Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment**
* **Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor**
* **Ability to meet deadlines**
* **Ability to provide clear guidance to others**

  
**The team**  
  
**Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to align with the evolving business objectives of organizations. We collaborate with CFOs, CAOs, controllers, and treasurers to develop an efficient, high-quality, data-driven, and tech-enabled controllership and treasury function. This empowers our clients to deliver greater value to their business partners and investors.**  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* **3+ years of experience in accounting, finance transformation, financial planning and analysis, or cost accounting**
* **Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Risk Management, or Economics**
* **One or more of the following: Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Cost Accountant (CCA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA), Financial Risk Manager (FRM), or progress toward one of these credentials**
* **Experience with automation tools, including Alteryx workflows or Microsoft 365 Copilot**
* **Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.**
* **Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.**

  
**Preferred:**  

* **Master's degree in Business, Information Systems, or Accounting**
* **Experience with internal controls or Sarbanes-Oxley compliance**
* **Experience using or administering enterprise resource planning (ERP) finance and reporting platforms, including SAP, Oracle, Workday, or JD Edwards**
* **Experience with process mapping, gap analysis, requirements definition, financial modeling, or value mapping**
* **Experience with Record to Report processes and tools such as Workiva and BlackLine, including account reconciliations and close management**

  
**The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 to $229,100.**  
  
**You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.**

jobs.description:
Four Seasons Building Products, a division of Latium USA, is one of the largest manufacturers of outdoor living products in the home improvement industry. With 20 Service Centers across North America, FSBP has created a network that provides the best support for our customers around the country. FSBP specializes in transforming outdoor living spaces with patio covers, pool enclosures, awnings, lattices and pergolas.

Four Seasons Building Products is currently seeking an experienced Buyer / Inventory Control Analyst to join our thriving manufacturing business in Southern California. At our manufacturing location for the West Coast business, serving locations with over $40 million in sales, you will work in a dynamic environment, controlling material supply for the region, maintaining accurate inventory, and improving and professionalizing our purchasing and inventory processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Purchase raw materials, components and supplies to ensure uninterrupted supply to manufacturing across multiple locations

· Negotiate pricing, lead times and terms with vendors; manage vendor relationships and performance

· Monitor and manage inventory levels for 1,000+ SKUs, setting and maintaining min/max, reorder points and safety stock

· Plan and coordinate cycle counts and physical inventories; investigate and resolve variances

· Analyze usage, forecasts and lead times to balance material availability against inventory carrying costs

· Identify slow-moving, obsolete and excess inventory and recommend corrective action

· Maintain accurate item, purchasing and inventory data in the ERP system

· Build Excel-based reports and KPIs (inventory accuracy, turns, fill rate, on-time delivery) for management

· Partner with production, warehouse, and accounting teams to improve purchasing and inventory control processes

**Qualifications**

· A minimum of 3 years of purchasing and/or inventory control experience in a multi-location manufacturing environment

· Experience negotiating with vendors and vendor management

· Strong attention to detail (managing 1,000+ SKUs to ensure uninterrupted supply to manufacturing)

· Excellent analytical skills with advanced experience manipulating data in Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP)

· Working knowledge of inventory control practices such as cycle counting, reorder planning and inventory reconciliation

· ERP experience in a multi-site environment (Syteline experience a plus)

· Strong communication and organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities

· 4-year college degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field would be a plus; APICS/ASCM certification a plus

**What We Offer**

The company offers a full benefits package including medical, dental and vision care, employee life insurance and a 401(k) with company matching.

Please attach a resume, cover letter and salary requirements describing your interest in this position.

Your expertise will help us deliver quality products efficiently while fostering strong vendor partnerships that propel our success forward.

John Paul Mitchell Systems (“JPMS”) is recognized worldwide for developing and marketing innovative hair and skin care products since 1980. We’ve been serving the professional beauty industry with salon-quality hair care products, styling tools and professional hair color through our family of brands including Paul Mitchell, MITCH, Awapuhi Wild Ginger, Tea Tree, Paul Mitchell Tools, Neuro, The Demi, Paul Mitchell the Color, Blonde, and Color XG.

We were the first professional hair care company to take a stand against animal testing and continue our strong commitment to giving back, supporting a wide range of philanthropic causes both domestically and internationally. Sustainability has always been a priority, and we are committed to making our company operations climate neutral to preserve the beauty of the world around us.

* Ability to make and manage tight deadlines

jobs.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Supervisor
jobs.description:
The Finance Team provides centralized financial management, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic analysis to departmental leadership and operational stakeholders. The Financial Reporting team partners closely with UCSF Health, the School of Medicine Dean’s Office, and departmental leadership to support data-driven decision-making, operational planning, and long-term financial stewardship.

Responsible for supervising the department’s reporting and analytical activities, including budget development, forecasting, productivity reporting, executive reporting, workforce planning, and long-range financial modeling.

Provides leadership and direction to Financial Reporting Analysts supporting UCSF Health, ZSFG/Oakland, faculty projects, and departmental strategic initiatives. Oversees complex financial analyses and strategic planning activities and serves as a key advisor to departmental leadership on operational performance, financial stewardship, and long-range planning.

Exercises independent judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Oversees highly complex financial issues requiring advanced analytical expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to synthesize information from multiple operational and financial systems into actionable recommendations.

  

**Department Overview**

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care at UCSF provides outstanding patient care, promotes cutting-edge basic and clinical science research, and educates the next generation of healthcare providers while focusing on the UCSF Principles of Community.

  

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care ranks as one of the largest departments in the School of Medicine, with an annual budget of $207 million. The three largest components of the annual revenue budget are Funds Flow Revenue, the affiliation agreement with the city and county of San Francisco, and Extramural Funds, which together represent 85.2% or $171 million. As of 2026, the department has over 200 Faculty members, 27 Staff Physicians, 200 Staff Employees, 6 Fellows, 90 Residents, 17 Non-Faculty Academics, 13 Post Docs, and 8 Nurse Practitioners. The department also works closely with 68 Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs).

  

In addition to the Moffitt-Long Hospital, very active units of the department exist at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) (inpatient and outpatient, including an active trauma service); San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (inpatient and outpatient); Mount Zion Medical Center (outpatient, including 23 hour stays); Benioff Children's Hospital Oakland; the UCSF Orthopedic Institute; the Benioff Children's, Betty Irene Moore Women's and Bakar Cancer (NIH-designated Cancer Center) Hospitals; and the Bayfront Medical Building (outpatient, Center for Pain Medicine) in the Mission Bay neighborhood.

  

The Department now has essential roles in patient care outside of the operating rooms, with active participation in Ambulatory Care, Acute and Chronic Pain, and in the Preoperative Clinic. Since 1958, the department has been at the heart of modern anesthesia’s explosive growth, and to this day continues to have an enormous impact on surgical practice and the management of pain. The department’s research, education, and clinical care earned and have maintained reputations equal to or better than that of any institution in the world. Individual members of our faculty have had a major influence on our specialty both nationally and internationally, including NIH study sections, NIH funding, and FDA and Editorial Boards. Research activities within the department are integrated with and inform clinical practice. For many years, ours has been among the top departments in the United States for NIH research funding in anesthesia.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible financial analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and strategic finance experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience as a lead/supervisor/manager.
* Extensive knowledge of finance policies, practices and systems, budgeting and reporting techniques, accounting and bookkeeping.
* Solid understanding of financial and resource planning concepts as well as how to control organizational budgeting.
* Ability to prepare and present materials to internal and external constituents.
* Extensive knowledge of human resource policies, practices, and planning.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing.
* Advanced skills in the use of spreadsheet and database software.
* Demonstrated interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively across the organization at all levels.
* Proven ability to deal with changing priorities and direct the work of others accordingly. Ability to multi-task.
* Demonstrated ability to screen applications, interview candidates, and either make selection decisions or recommend individuals for hire.
* Thorough knowledge and understanding of internal control practices and their impact on protecting University resources.
* Client services oriented; has good listening, communication, critical thinking, and analytical skills.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in academic healthcare, higher education, or complex matrix organization.
* Experience with UCSF financial systems and reporting tools including PLUS, MyReports, EPIC reporting, and UC Path.
* Experience with productivity metrics, funds flow modeling, and faculty compensation analysis.
* Experience developing executive dashboards and enterprise reporting frameworks.
* Experience in healthcare finance or academic medicine.
  

**Preferred Certifications**

* CPA or related financial certification.

Founded in 1965, Prometheus is the largest privately held owner of apartments in the San Francisco Bay Area, with a portfolio of over 13,000 apartments in the Silicon Valley, Portland, and Seattle regions. We invest in real estate long-term and the focus on enduring quality drives every element of what we do - from our selection of locations to design decisions, reinvestments into our Neighborhoods and our operating strategy.

We are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, part of a group of companies that meets the highest standards for using business as a force for good. We have more than 500 Prometheans, and have a home office in San Mateo, with satellite offices in Portland, Oregon, and in the Bay Area. We are a vertically integrated company with four main core competencies in-house: acquisitions/investments, development, value-add renovations, and operations/property management. Prometheus has a long history of award-winning approaches to what we do, receiving over 100 awards for design and excellence including Fortune Magazine's list of 100 Best Small & Medium Companies, the 100 Best Workplaces for Women and Best Places to Work in the Bay Area.

These are the defining characteristics of a Promethean: Team Oriented, Communicator, Entrepreneurial, Passionate, Self-Starter, Creative, Principled, and Brand Ambassador.

jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves analytical studies on a variety of policies, projects, programs, and issues in support of a function, research initiative, program, and/or organizational unit, or in research of new or changing systems and programs. Assists in policy and program planning, development, administration, management, and implementation; interprets, monitors, and analyzes information regarding policies and procedures, and provides consultative services to department administrators and other stakeholders.

**Generic Scope**

Professional who applies acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to complete substantive assignments/projects/tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action.

**Custom Scope**

Applies professional concepts to conduct analytical studies or projects of moderate scope and complexity to address a variety of policy, research, and procedural issues. Fully analyzes issues and problems, gathers data and information, finds and evaluates alternatives, and makes sound recommendations.

Under the general direction of the Principal Investigator, the incumbent provides analytical, operational, and project coordination support for a PCORI-funded research and implementation program focused on expanding access to evidence-based, group-based intensive lifestyle intervention for obesity treatment across UCSF primary care settings. The incumbent applies project and policy analysis concepts to support implementation activities, stakeholder engagement, clinic coordination, clinician training, patient recruitment and enrollment workflows, program material development, data collection and analysis, evaluation activities, and sponsor reporting.

Working collaboratively with faculty investigators, clinical leaders, Population Health, IT/analytics partners, clinic staff, and patient and community advisors, the incumbent coordinates day-to-day project activities, gathers and analyzes qualitative and quantitative information, monitors implementation progress, identifies operational issues, and develops recommendations to improve project effectiveness, implementation fidelity, and equitable access to evidence-based care.

The position supports implementation of a year-long group-based obesity treatment program delivered through UCSF primary care clinics using both virtual and in-person formats. The project emphasizes health equity, patient-centered implementation, cultural responsiveness, stakeholder engagement, implementation fidelity, evaluation, dissemination, and long-term sustainability. The incumbent provides analytical and project support to facilitate the successful implementation of the research program and the achievement of project objectives.

**Department Overview**

The Department of Medicine (DOM) is the largest department in the School of Medicine (SOM) at UCSF, with more than 600 full-time faculty members. The mission of the Department includes research, teaching, patient care, and public service. The Department has a decentralized organizational structure across four locations (Mission Bay, Parnassus Heights, San Francisco Veterans Affairs Health Care System, and the Zuckerberg San Francisco General) and approximately 38 divisions. UCSF DOM has consistently ranked among the top four departments of medicine in the country. Authority and accountability for the Department rest with the Department Chair (who leads the Parnassus Heights site) and with the Vice Chairs/Chiefs at SFVAHCS and ZSFG.

The Division of General Internal Medicine (DGIM) is one of the divisions within DOM and SOM. DGIM, one of the larger Divisions in DOM, is home to a spectacular group of faculty, learners, and staff committed to outstanding patient care, research, and education. DGIM is a national leader in clinical care, education, and research, and our mission is to provide high-quality, accessible clinical care, train the future leaders of primary care, and conduct cutting-edge research across a wide variety of disciplines, including health outcomes related to socioeconomic and ethnic factors. DGIM has more than 80 faculty, almost 45 MSPs/VCPs/post-doctoral trainees, over 73 learners, and 150+ staff (both Campus and Health), and we serve more than 25,000 diverse patients, with expenditures over $33M.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Financial Analyst – Mining Project Economic ModelingJob Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Financial Analyst to support the development of a conceptual-level economic and financial model for a mining project.

The primary responsibility of this role will be to develop an integrated financial model incorporating project production assumptions, revenues, operating costs (OPEX), capital expenditures (CAPEX), taxes, working capital, financing assumptions, and other relevant economic parameters.

The model will be used to evaluate the economic viability of the project and will include key financial indicators such as Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), payback period, and project cash flow.

The Financial Analyst will also support the preparation of projected Profit & Loss (P&L), Cash Flow Statement, and Balance Sheet as part of the project deliverables.

This opportunity is particularly suited to firms with experience in mining, natural resources, infrastructure, energy, or other capital-intensive projects.

**Please note: This engagement is open only to companies legally established and authorized to conduct business in the United States. The selected firm will be engaged as an independent contractor. Individual employment arrangements will not be considered.**

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain an integrated conceptual-level financial model for a mining project, primarily using Microsoft Excel.
* Integrate project assumptions including production schedules, commodity prices, recoveries, revenues, CAPEX, OPEX, royalties, taxes, working capital, and other relevant economic parameters.
* Calculate key project economic indicators, including:
* Net Present Value (NPV)
* Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
* Payback Period
* Project and equity cash flows
* Prepare projected financial statements, including:
* Profit & Loss Statement (P&L / Income Statement)
* Cash Flow Statement
* Balance Sheet
* Develop annual project cash-flow forecasts over the expected Life of Mine (LOM).
* Perform sensitivity and scenario analyses for key project variables such as commodity prices, production, CAPEX, OPEX, recovery, and discount rates.
* Support the evaluation of alternative project development scenarios and provide financial insights to the technical and project management teams.
* Review financial and technical assumptions received from engineering disciplines and ensure their appropriate integration into the financial model.
* Clearly document model assumptions, calculations, inputs, outputs, and key financial results.
* Prepare tables, charts, and summaries for inclusion in the project's conceptual technical and economic report.
* Work collaboratively with mining, processing, infrastructure, environmental, and project management professionals.

Requirements

* The applicant must represent a company legally established and authorized to conduct business in the United States.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field for the professional(s) assigned to the project.
* Demonstrated experience developing financial models and project economic evaluations.
* Strong understanding of NPV, IRR, discount rates, cash flow modeling, and investment evaluation.
* Good understanding of the interaction between P&L, Cash Flow Statement, and Balance Sheet.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including development of structured and auditable financial models.
* Experience with CAPEX and OPEX analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
* Ability to interpret technical and operational information and translate it into financial assumptions.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to clearly present financial results and explain model assumptions to technical and non-financial stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience in mining project evaluation, mining finance, project finance, or natural resources.
* Experience developing financial models for conceptual studies, Scoping Studies, Preliminary Economic Assessments (PEA), Pre-Feasibility Studies (PFS), or similar project evaluations.
* Familiarity with mining concepts such as Life of Mine (LOM), production schedules, processing recoveries, commodity pricing, royalties, sustaining CAPEX, closure costs, and operating costs.
* Experience performing sensitivity, scenario, and risk analyses for capital-intensive projects.

The ideal firm will combine strong financial modeling capabilities with an understanding of project economics and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams.

Work Location: Remote

Pay: From $80.00 per hour

jobs.description:
**Why Mozilla?**

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

**About this team and role:**

Mozilla Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation, overseeing day-to-day financial operations as we scale our mission impact with new and existing products, technology, and business models.

Core Services brings together the functions Mozilla runs on: Legal, People, Data Science, Trust & Safety / Customer Experience, Strategy, IT, Cloud Engineering & Ecosystems, and Security - teams supporting every part of the Company.

We are seeking a detail-driven Senior Financial Analyst, Core Services to execute the recurring planning, reporting, and analysis that supports this portfolio. This role will be responsible for preparing the forecast, reconciling actuals through close, maintaining headcount and vendor tracking, and producing the reporting that reaches budget owners and the COO. This role reports to the Finance Manager, Core Services, who leads business partnership with the functional leaders, and works closely with teams across the organization.

To succeed, you will need to work accurately across a broad portfolio, translate variances into explanations a non-finance audience can act on, and balance competing cycle deadlines with outstanding attention to detail. This position requires a resourceful self-starter who takes recurring processes from start to finish and improves them along the way.

**What you'll do:**

* **Prepare the Core Services forecast each cycle.** Build and load cost center detail in Pigment, validate inputs, reconcile against the prior cycle, and document what moved along with the drivers behind it.
* **Assemble the monthly budget update.** Prepare variance to plan, drivers, and open items for budget owners and the COO, ready for the Finance Manager to carry into leader conversations.
* **Partner with Accounting through monthly close.** Tie out actuals, accruals, and forecast, and resolve coding and timing issues at the source rather than correcting for them downstream.
* **Maintain headcount tracking.** Keep position-level tracking and the headcount-to-plan bridge current, coordinating with People and hiring managers on start dates and backfill assumptions.
* **Track vendor and cloud spend.** Monitor POs, commitments, renewals, and run-rate changes across the group. Take in cloud cost information prepared by the Cloud Engineering team, carry it into Core Services and consolidated Company reporting, and review it for anomalies and initial questions.
* **Apply AI and automation to recurring work.** Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across the forecast, close, and reporting cycle, improving the speed and reliability of what the team produces. Experiment with tools and share what works.
* **Support Core Services teams day to day.** Field data and reporting questions directly, escalating items that call for a partnership discussion.

**What you'll bring:**

**Core Experience**

* 5+ years of work experience in business unit FP&A, corporate FP&A, strategic finance, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.
* Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).
* Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.
* Enough familiarity with cloud cost or FinOps concepts to interpret reporting prepared by a technical team and question what looks off.
* Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.
* Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance concisely to a non-finance audience.
* Ability to work across functions, distilling detail into structured summaries that leaders can act on.
* Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and ability to learn quickly.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience supporting technical or G&A functions in a shared-services finance environment, where the internal team is the customer.
* Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context — or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.
* Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.

**Success Factors**

You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

* Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.
* Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adj

The successful candidate will oversee a group of project monitors providing programmatic, technical, and operational support across the full project lifecycle, including negotiations, technical due diligence, go/no-go reviews, contract modifications, invoice reviews, milestone tracking, and quarterly progress assessments.

This role requires a strong background in commercial demonstration project development, knowledge of federal processes, excellent analytical and communication skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with government stakeholders, contractors, and interdisciplinary project teams.

**Position Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide programmatic and technical support for active federal financial assistance awards, including grants and cooperative agreements, and Other Transaction (OT) awards
* Support project negotiations and go/no-go decision reviews by evaluating technical, financial, and performance data.
* Review and support contract and award modifications, ensuring compliance with federal policies and program requirements.

* Track project milestones, deliverables, and performance metrics; maintain accurate project records and reporting tools.
* Support and participate in quarterly progress reviews, including preparation of briefing materials, analysis, and follow-up actions.

* Provide engineering, technical, and operational leadership support to active projects throughout execution.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely reviews, approvals, and decision-making.
* Conduct project or performance analysis during phase-down activities to capture lessons learned and inform future programs.
* Support document review and evaluation, program assessments, and preparation of high-quality reports and presentations.
* Provide meeting planning, facilitation, and documentation support, including action tracking and follow-up.

**Position Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering
* U.S. Citizenship
* Demonstrated experience supporting federal programs, with a strong preference for Department of Energy (DOE) experience.
* Experience in the development and management of first-of-a-kind commercial demonstration projects.
* Experience providing programmatic support for active financial assistance projects (e.g., grants, cooperative agreements).
* Strong background in documentation disciplines, including technical writing, editing, document development, layout, and production.
* Proven ability to perform complex problem-solving and analytical tasks in a federal government environment.
* Experience supporting briefings, presentations, program evaluations, and formal documentation.
* Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Master’s degree in a related field.
* Direct experience supporting DOE offices, laboratories, or energy-related programs.

The United States Space Force (USSF) Space Systems Command (SSC) at Los Angeles Air Force Base, California is searching for a Budget Analyst (NH-0501-03, GS-12/13 equivalent).

The Finance Office provides financial management and decision support to programs in the Missile Warning & Tracking and Space Based Sensing & Targeting Portfolios, enabling planning and execution of acquisition strategies and delivery of space capabilities in support of United States Space Force and Department of War. This financial manager's role will support various program offices within Space Systems Command.
  
  
Are you interested in supporting advanced space technologies in one of the most diverse areas in the country? Come join our team here in sunny Southern California at Space Systems Command. We are located in the city of El Segundo, gateway to the beaches. The area offers a multitude of sandy choices, from Santa Monica to Redondo with plenty of things to do in between including hiking trails, breweries, sporting events, museums, piers, theme parks, zoos, and more. 10. Ability to communicate effectively the results of evaluations and analysis.

jobs.description:
**About Sony Music Entertainment**

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As the Analyst, Global Artist Accounting at Ceremony of Roses, you will support artist accounting, royalty reporting, and financial operations across the Ceremony of Roses group of companies, which are part of Sony Music Entertainment. This role serves as a flexible shared resource across COR's affiliated businesses, providing support on a need-based basis as priorities and workloads shift across the group. You will partner with finance and operating teams across affiliates to help deliver timely and accurate artist settlements, interpret contractual economics, reconcile underlying financial activity, and support accurate financial reporting. Success in this role requires strong accounting and analytical skills, attention to detail, comfort working across multiple businesses and systems, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment. This is an office-first role located in Culver City, CA and requires working 4 days in office per week.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

*Artist Accounting & Royalty Settlements*

* Prepare and maintain artist royalty statements and settlement schedules across multiple revenue channels, including Tour, Ecommerce, Retail, and Licensing, for affiliates across the Ceremony of Roses group.
* Review artist contracts and related agreements to ensure accurate interpretation and application of royalty rates, profit splits, recoupable costs, advances, and other settlement terms.
* Reconcile revenue, costs, cash activity, and other settlement inputs to underlying operational and accounting records.
* Identify settlement discrepancies, investigate variances, and coordinate with affiliate finance and operating teams to resolve issues on a timely basis.

*Affiliate Support & Workload Triage*

* Provide artist accounting and finance support across Ceremony of Roses affiliated companies based on business needs, settlement calendars, and workload priorities.
* Partner with finance leads across the group to assess open deliverables, prioritize work, and provide additional capacity where it is most needed.
* Adapt to different affiliate processes, systems, and business models while helping drive consistency in artist accounting practices across the group.

*Financial Analysis & Reporting*

* Support analysis of artist and project economics, including revenue, costs, margins, royalties, and settlement performance across revenue channels.
* Assist with variance analysis and other financial reporting needed to explain artist, project, or affiliate performance.

jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description:
**About Copperfit Industries**

Copperfit Industries is a family-owned manufacturer and distributor of plumbing products serving wholesale customers throughout North America and Asia since 1999. We offer a broad range of copper, brass, PVC, PEX, and related plumbing products and are committed to quality, responsive service, and strong long-term relationships with our customers and suppliers.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Buyer to join our Procurement team. This role works closely with suppliers, overseas manufacturers, Sales, Warehouse, Logistics, and Accounting to ensure products are sourced, ordered, produced, and delivered on time.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, comfortable communicating directly with factories and suppliers, and able to independently follow purchasing activities from initial requirement through delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare, issue, update, and track purchase orders in the ERP system
* Purchase materials, components, finished goods, and inventory from approved domestic and international suppliers
* Communicate with suppliers and factories regarding pricing, product requirements, production status, lead times, and delivery schedules
* Follow up on open purchase orders and escalate delays, shortages, quality concerns, or supply issues
* Request and compare supplier quotations to support sourcing and purchasing decisions
* Monitor assigned inventory items and initiate replenishment based on established reorder levels and business needs
* Coordinate with Sales regarding customer requirements, product availability, special orders, and expected timing
* Coordinate with Warehouse and Logistics regarding inbound shipments and delivery schedules
* Maintain accurate supplier, pricing, lead time, purchase order, and order status information in the ERP system
* Assist with resolving quantity, pricing, delivery, and invoice discrepancies with suppliers and Accounting
* Maintain strong day-to-day supplier relationships and follow up on open items
* Support other purchasing and procurement activities as assigned

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 1+ years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory, import/export, order management, or related experience preferred
* Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English required
* Ability to communicate effectively with factories and suppliers in China by email, phone, WeChat, or other business communication channels
* Experience working with overseas suppliers or manufacturers preferred
* Experience in manufacturing, wholesale distribution, plumbing, hardware, industrial products, or a related industry is a plus
* Basic understanding of purchase orders, supplier coordination, inventory, and purchasing processes
* Strong organizational and follow up skills
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple purchase orders, deadlines, and changing priorities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ability to learn ERP systems
* Strong problem solving and communication skills
* Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities while escalating significant issues appropriately

Pay: $23.00 - $26.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Buyer
jobs.description:
The Senior Buyer owns procurement of assigned ingredient categories for frozen and refrigerated prepared meals. This is a senior individual contributor role that goes well beyond transactional purchasing. The Senior Buyer leads supplier negotiations, manages commodity cost and supply risk across volatile ingredient markets, and protects continuity of supply at target cost, quality, and food safety standards.

As the category lead for their assigned commodities, the Senior Buyer sets the sourcing approach, drives cost-down initiatives, and serves as the go-to expert for those categories across Operations, Planning, R&D, Quality, and Finance. The role helps raise the capability of the purchasing team.

*Key Responsibilities*

**Sourcing and Procurement**

* Own day-to-day buying for assigned ingredient categories (proteins, produce, dairy, dry goods, and other raw materials) to meet production schedules without supply interruption.
* Convert demand and material requirements into purchase orders at the right quantity, timing, and cost, working from MRP output and planner input.
* Set and maintain sourcing strategy for assigned categories, including single vs. multi-source decisions and supplier qualification pipeline (in partnership with QA and R&D).
* Manage purchase order accuracy, confirmations, and on-time delivery; resolve shortages, delays, and discrepancies before they hit the production floor.

**Supplier Management and Negotiation**

* Lead commercial negotiations for assigned categories: price, payment terms, lead times, minimum order quantities, and service levels.
* Build and manage supplier relationships, run regular business reviews, and hold suppliers accountable to cost, quality, and delivery commitments.
* Own contracts and pricing agreements for assigned categories, including renewals and renegotiations ahead of expiration.

**Cost and Risk Management**

* Track commodity markets and cost drivers for assigned categories; forecast cost movement and flag risk to the Senior Purchasing Manager and Finance early.
* Lead cost-down and cost-avoidance initiatives and document realized savings.
* Manage supply risk through buffer strategies, alternate sourcing, and contingency plans for high-risk or single-source items.

**Cross-Functional and Compliance**

* Partner with Planning on demand signals and inventory targets, with QA on supplier and ingredient quality, and with R&D on new ingredient sourcing for product development.
* Maintain accurate purchasing data in the ERP (xTuple), including item, vendor, pricing, and lead-time records for assigned categories.
* Support food safety and regulatory compliance in sourcing decisions (supplier approval status, documentation, FEFO-friendly ordering).

**Leadership and Mentorship**

* Help the Senior Purchasing Manager improve purchasing processes, controls, and reporting.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of purchasing or procurement experience in food or beverage manufacturing.
* Direct experience buying ingredient commodities (proteins, produce, dairy, or dry goods) with real exposure to commodity price volatility.
* Proven negotiation track record with measurable cost savings.
* Strong working knowledge of MRP and ERP systems and purchasing workflows.
* Solid Excel skills (analysis, cost comparisons, supplier scorecards).
* Understanding of food safety and quality basics in a manufacturing setting (GMPs, supplier approval, lot and shelf-life considerations).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work across Operations, Planning, QA, R&D, and Finance.

**Essential job functions**

* Lift, push, pull 30 lbs unaided
* Turning, twisting, Squatting, Kneeling, bending, stooping, standing and walking
* hand motion, left hand and right hand including forceful gripping
* bility to climb stairs
* Other duties task and responsibilities may be assigned at any time

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* Experience with xTuple or a comparable manufacturing ERP.
* CPSM, CSCP, or APICS certification.
* Experience in frozen or refrigerated prepared foods.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred, but not required.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Buyer experience?

Experience:

* Purchasing: 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Multifamily Asset Management Analyst
jobs.description:
MIG Real Estate (“MIG”) is a privately held real estate investment firm focused on the acquisition, repositioning, and long-term ownership of multifamily and commercial assets. MIG emphasizes disciplined underwriting, hands-on asset management, and strong third-party operating partnerships to drive long-term value creation.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Multifamily Asset Management Analyst supports senior Asset and Revenue Managers in executing business plans across MIG’s multifamily portfolio of over 6,200 units in Arizona, California, Colorado and Washington. This role blends financial analysis with operational oversight, working closely with third-party property management teams to drive performance, accountability, and value creation. This key individual will report to the Chief Financial Officer to assist in the monitoring, management and performance improvement of MIG’s multifamily properties.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Asset Management & Performance Monitoring

* Monitor asset performance versus budget, forecast, underwriting and overall market conditions
* Analyze operating statements, rent rolls, and variance reports
* Identify risks and performance gaps and support corrective action planning
* Assist in developing portfolio standards and benchmarking
* Prepare regular reports on leasing, financial, key operating metrics and capital performance

Budgeting, Forecasting & Business Planning

* Assist with preparation of annual operating budgets and capital plans
* Support development of annual asset-level business plans outlining operating strategy, capital initiatives, leasing goals, and KPIs
* Coordinate budget assumptions and inputs with third-party property management teams
* Assist with coordination and preparation of quarterly five-year property rolling forecasts

Third-Party Property Management Oversight

* Serve as a liaison between MIG and third-party property managers
* Review KPIs including occupancy, rent growth, expenses, collections, and leasing velocity
* Participate in recurring performance review calls

On-Site Asset Reviews & Site Audits

* Conduct routine on-site property visits to evaluate operations and physical condition
* Perform structured inspections of units, common areas, and back-of-house operations
* Utilize MIG’s technology suite to document findings, action items, ownership, and timelines
* Track follow-up items to completion and prepare post-visit summaries

Leasing, Marketing & Systems Oversight

* Audit property websites and online presence for accuracy, branding consistency, and pricing integrity
* Review online leasing funnels and lead capture effectiveness
* Monitor and evaluate leasing prospect management, including lead response times, follow-up activity, data quality, and conversion metrics
* Partner with property management to improve lead-to-lease conversion
* Conduct regular review/test of marketing/advertising channels for effectiveness and ROI

Project Management & Strategic Support

* Track capital expenditures and renovation programs, including measurement of value-add returns
* Support due diligence for acquisitions, refinancings, and dispositions
* Track value-add initiatives and progress
* Assist in discovering, assessing, and implementing new technologies that drive NOI and increased property values

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Business, or related field
* 5–7 years of experience in real estate asset management, property management oversight, or real estate finance
* Multifamily experience preferred
* Strong financial and analytical capabilities
* Advanced Excel proficiency; experience with Yardi, Knock CRM, Microsoft Power BI and RealPage AIRM preferred
* Strong communication, organization, and follow-up skills
* Willingness to travel for periodic property site visits

Operations Finance serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating operational priorities into clear financial plans, identifying risks and opportunities, and helping the company deliver safe, reliable, affordable, innovative service to customers.
  
  
This role will support the Information Technology organization with a dedicated focus on artificial intelligence initiatives, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI-enabled automation, model consumption, cloud AI services, and emerging AI capabilities. The role will help PG&E apply financial rigor to AI investments by connecting technical usage patterns to measurable business value, ensuring savings are validated and captured, and building repeatable standards for AI business cases, cost governance, and value realization. The successful candidate will be a strategic finance partner who understands both the AI landscape and the business case discipline required to convert AI activity into tangible financial outcomes.
  
  
The role will evaluate AI opportunities across the development lifecycle, determine whether value is expense reduction, capital deferral, productivity, risk reduction, customer experience improvement, or other measurable benefit, and ensure that benefits are modeled, validated, budget-owner-owned, and ultimately taken to the bottom line where applicable. * Short-term disability, long-term disability, maternity and parental leave
* Gym/fitness reimbursement and tuition reimbursement
* Flexible savings account & Health savings account
* Paid holidays and up to 3 days paid community and volunteer leave
* Life and AD&D insurance.
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
* Access to wellness program
* Employee discount program
* Additional voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, critical illness, accident insurance, hospital indemnity, and legal plan

**OUR VISION**

Unleashing human potential to maximize company performance. We address a critical business need: to incentivize employees and align their behaviors with company goals.

**OUR CORE VALUES**

Customer Focus | Accountability | Respect | Excellence (CARE) are the keys to our success, and each day we’re committed to upholding them by delivering the best we can to our customers.

Xactly is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Xactly provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. By doing this, everyone in the Xactly family has the power to make a difference and unleash their full potential.

**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Senior Analyst, FP&A

**Location:** Remote | USA, Canada
  
**Reports to:** Senior Manager, FP&A

**Employment Type:** Full-time

This is a new vacancy
  
  
**About the Role:**

The Senior Analyst, FP&A will lead core financial planning, analysis, and performance management activities across JD Power’s Dealer and FSAAS (Financial Services and other Adjacent Services) GTM (Go-To-Market) verticals. This role will own key forecasting and reporting processes, develop scalable financial models and executive-ready insights, and partner directly with Finance leadership, product & business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape investment decisions, product roadmap prioritization, resource allocation, and strategic planning in a fast-moving, data-driven environment.
  
  
This position is well-suited for a seasoned, highly analytical finance professional who can independently lead complex analyses, influence senior product and technology partners, create new planning and reporting capabilities, and translate financial insights into clear recommendations that support product and technology priorities across the Dealer and FSAAS verticals.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead budgeting, planning, forecasting, reporting, and financial performance management processes for key areas across the Dealer and FSAAS verticals.
* Create and enhance financial models, KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and planning frameworks that improve executive visibility and enable data-driven product investment decisions.
* Use BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar), SQL/Databricks/Snowflake, and financial systems to design and deliver accurate, scalable reporting on Dealer and FSAAS top-line performance, and key business drivers.
* Develop insights and recommendations for business leaders on budget performance, variance drivers, forecast risks and opportunities, investment trade-offs, and cost-optimization opportunities across technology investments and vendor spend.
* Support the development of monthly and quarterly executive and board-level materials, translating complex financial and operational data into clear narratives for senior technology and product leadership.
* Drive cross-functional planning with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to align roadmap planning, investment priorities, and resource allocation decisions.
* Identify, develop, and implement process improvements and automation opportunities, including use of AI tools and data automation to increase forecast accuracy, planning efficiency, and executive visibility.
Lead ad hoc financial analyses and special projects for the FP&A leadership, CFO, and Dealer & FSAAS leadership, including framing the business question, building the analysis, and communicating actionable recommendations.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related analytical discipline.
* 8-10 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, FP&A, corporate finance, product/technology operations, or a related analytical role; experience supporting executive, product, and technology leadership is strongly preferred.
* Experience working in SaaS/technology companies and private equity portfolio company environments is strongly preferred.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including experience with pivot tables, lookups, and structured financial analysis; familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI is a strong plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to lead financial planning processes, create new analytical frameworks, influence cross-functional product and technology stakeholders, and turn data into executive-level recommendations.
* Ability to communicate financial concepts clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
* Comfort working independently, managing ambiguity, and adapting to changing priorities.
Familiarity with operating expense management, headcount planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and executive reporting is a strong plus. Experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, Adaptive Planning, Tableau, Power BI, or similar systems is also valued.

This position has a starting salary range of $80,000 - $94,000 USD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

The Financial Analyst supports the financial performance of customer programs through data analysis, reporting, billing review, and account reconciliation. This role connects information across systems, investigates differences, and explains findings clearly to Finance and operational partners. The analyst helps ensure financial activity is accurate, well supported, and useful for business decisions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Financial Analysis & Reporting**

* Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, explain variances, and provide practical recommendations.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports on revenue, receivables, cash activity, and customer program performance.
* Develop clear analyses and reporting tools that help stakeholders understand results and make informed decisions.

**Billing & Account Reconciliation**

* Review billing and related activity for accuracy and completeness; investigate discrepancies from source data through resolution.
* Reconcile balances and transactions across reports, customer records, and the general ledger, maintaining clear support for conclusions.
* Monitor open items and work with internal partners to resolve financial questions in a timely manner.

**Month-End & Financial Controls**

* Support month-end close through account reconciliations, accruals, journal entries, and supporting schedules.
* Assist with revenue and deferred revenue analysis and reconciliations as needed.
* Maintain reliable documentation and follow established financial controls and approval processes.

**Collaboration & Improvement**

* Partner with Finance, Client Services, and Operations to understand business activity and its financial impact.
* Interpret relevant contract terms and business processes to support accurate billing and reporting.
* Identify ways to improve data quality, reporting, and the efficiency of financial processes.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 3 years of experience in financial analysis, financial operations, or a related finance role.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to work with large datasets, investigate differences, and explain findings.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.
* Clear communication, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience with billing, receivables, reconciliations, or month-end reporting.
* Experience with ERP systems, reporting tools, or process improvement.
* Familiarity with GAAP and revenue recognition principles.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**
=======================================

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for long periods of time, use hands to type, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Prefer candidates who can type at least 35 words per minute with 97% accuracy.
* Although very minimal, flexibility to travel as needed is preferred.
* This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc.

**Why Work for Valeris?**
=========================

We’re committed to supporting the well-being and success of our team members. As part of our organization, full-time employees can expect:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans, including HSA- and FSA-eligible options, with Valeris contributing toward premium costs
* Additional health support, including telehealth and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
* Company match on Health Savings Account contributions
* Free Basic Life and AD&D coverage equal to your annual earnings, with a minimum of $50,000 and a maximum of $300,000
* Company-paid Short-Term Disability coverage, with the option to purchase Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% match on the first 5% you contribute, with immediate vesting
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave to support work-life balance
* Team members receive nine paid holidays plus two floating holidays
* Opportunities for advancement in a company that supports personal and professional growth
* A challenging, stimulating work environment that encourages new ideas
* Work for a company that values diversity and makes deliberate efforts to create an inclusive workplace
* A mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work makes a meaningful impact

Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and, depending on the position, a drug screen in accordance with company standards. Please note that this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all dutie

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Procurement Analyst supports logistics operations for four USCIS regions and 130 geographically dispersed USCIS ASC locations. Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role provides comprehensive project management support across key logistics functions, including procurement, property control, FAR compliance, SOP development, and funds expenditure control.

In the absence of the Senior Logistics Manager, this position serves as the primary point of contact, ensuring continuity of operations and decision-making. Additionally, the role ensures strict adherence to Quality Assurance policies, organizational goals, and Environmental Health & Safety standards in all procurement and logistics processes.

**Position Accountabilities**

* Analyze procurement metrics, including cost savings, supplier performance, and spend analysis, to generate reports and dashboards that provide insights to leadership and support data-driven decision-making and process improvements.
* Monitors Purchasing activities with the Senior Logistics Manager to ensure expeditious requirements fills, to include proper coding to Accounts Payable (AP).
* Review, verify, and reconcile invoices against contracts, purchase orders, and delivery records to ensure accuracy and prevent overpayments.
* Works the inventory management program, maintaining the master inventory records for all site locations, to include disposal requirements IAW regulations and procedures
* Coordinates quarterly property inventory audits with all sites, updates master inventory records and provides property accountability changes, additions and deletions to the Property Custodian.
* Assists in managing site relocations and expansions, in close coordination with the Facilities Department, Senior Logistics Manager and Site and Regional Managers.
* Coordinates logistics requirements with selected vendors regarding new property and furniture purchase, move/relocation requirements and applicable disposal requirements.
* Initiates Requests for Quotation (RFP) and Requests for Proposal (RFP) to Corporate Global Supplies Chain Management (GSCM) Buyers.
* Responsible for the adherence to all Amentum policies and procedures, to include applicable GSCM, Accounts Payable (AP) and USCIS policies/procedures.

**Minimum requirements**

* 4 yrs of procurement experience. This shall include property and supply procurement functions.
* Associate's degree

**Skills & Core Competencies**

* Data and Reporting Proficiency: Proficiency using spreadsheets, reports, trackers, dashboards, and large data sets to organize, monitor, validate, and summarize information.
* Analytical Thinking: Demonstrated ability to analyze, organize, reconcile, and validate business, logistics, procurement, inventory, or operational data; identify trends and inconsistencies; and support recommendations with facts.
* Data Accuracy & Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies, validate information, and maintain accurate and reliable records.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly communicate updates, findings, and recommendations to managers, team members, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Collaboration & Training: Ability to train, motivate, support, and work effectively with individuals and multiple departments across different locations and time zones.
* Process & Compliance: Working knowledge of standard operating procedures, documentation requirements, approval processes, and compliance-driven workflows.
* Coachability & Continuous Improvement: Receptive to feedback and direction, with the ability to learn new processes, adapt to changing requirements, and identify opportunities to improve workflows.

**Relevant Experience**

* Background supporting logistics, procurement, inventory, operations, administrative reporting, business analysis, or related program support functions.
* Demonstrated experience working with operational or business data to organize information, maintain reporting, reconcile records, and support decision-making.
* Experience working within established procedures, documentation standards, approval processes, or other structured operational environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience with pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, filters, data validation, charts, and reconciliation tools.
* 1+ year of logistics, supply chain, inventory, or related operational experience.
* Experience supporting multi-site, regional, or geographically dispersed operations.
* Experience developing reports, dashboards, metrics, or other analytical tools used to support management decision-making
* Ability to travel to the local Application Support Center (ASC) office to observe program operations and assist with the annual physical inventory, including lifting items up to 45 pounds

**Physical Demands**

* Sit or stand for extended period

**Unique Qualifications**

* Valid driver’s license
* Advanced in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel (advanced functions such as pivot tables and Vlookup) and Outlook
* Working knowledge of Deltek and Costpoint highly desirable

jobs.description:
**Your Responsibilities**

* You plan, launch and manage Meta ad campaigns (Facebook & Instagram), from campaign structure and audiences to budgets and bidding
* You monitor and interpret performance metrics daily (CTR, CPM, CPC, hook rate, hold rate, CPA, ROAS) and understand what is actually driving results
* You break down ads into their variables (hook, angle, format, creator, offer, length, CTA) and identify which elements win and which don't
* You make clear iteration decisions: what to scale, what to kill, and which new variants to test next
* You translate data into concrete briefings for creative strategists and editors, so every new ad is based on insights rather than guesswork
* You build and maintain reporting that makes performance and test learnings transparent to the team

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience as a media buyer for Meta ads, ideally in e-commerce or direct response (with examples of results and decisions you made)
* A strong analytical mindset: you are comfortable with numbers, spot patterns quickly and can distinguish signal from noise
* Solid understanding of creative testing frameworks and statistical significance
* Confident handling of Ads Manager, spreadsheets and reporting tools
* Fast turnaround and reliability with deadlines

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with attribution tools (e.g. Triple Whale, Northbeam) or GA4
* Understanding of UGC and direct-response creatives, so you can give editors precise feedback

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

**Duties**
----------

The United States Space Force (USSF) Space Systems Command (SSC) at Los Angeles Air Force Base, California is searching for a Budget Analyst (NH-0501-03, GS-12/13 equivalent).
  
  
**Description**:
  
The Finance Office provides financial management and decision support to programs in the Missile Warning & Tracking and Space Based Sensing & Targeting Portfolios, enabling planning and execution of acquisition strategies and delivery of space capabilities in support of United States Space Force and Department of War. This financial manager's role will support various program offices within Space Systems Command.
  
  
Are you interested in supporting advanced space technologies in one of the most diverse areas in the country? Come join our team here in sunny Southern California at Space Systems Command. We are located in the city of El Segundo, gateway to the beaches. The area offers a multitude of sandy choices, from Santa Monica to Redondo with plenty of things to do in between including hiking trails, breweries, sporting events, museums, piers, theme parks, zoos, and more. There is only 1 place in the world where you can surf and snowboard all on the same day, and it is in Southern California!
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**:
  
Business or Finance related college degree. At least 3 years of relevant experience as NH-02 or GS-11 equivalent. Preferred: DAWIA Certification (Practitioner Level) in Business or Cost Estimating or equivalent industry certification and/or CDFM-A. 5-10 years in acquisition financial management; participating in budget presentation and execution that included the application of budgeting and financial management laws, regulations, policies, precedents, and methods to formulate, justify, monitor budget activities; 5 years as a budget analyst on various ACAT programs; experience with challenging acquisition programs (e.g., breaches, Congressional notifications, innovative funding solutions, etc.
  
  
Advanced knowledge in budget and cost analysis techniques, tools, concepts and procedures. Strong leadership skills with excellent ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-starter with attention to detail. Collaborator. Proactive. Resilient. Growth mindset.
  
  
**Key Skills and Abilities**:
  
1. Knowledge of budget formulation and submission requirements.
  
2. Knowledge of budget obligations and expenditure concept.
  
3. Knowledge of cost and schedule performance measurement concepts.
  
4. Knowledge of contractor system requirements for earned value management systems.
  
5. Skill applying budget formulation concepts to generate cogent documents.
  
6. Skill in describing the results of contractor cost and schedule performance analysis.
  
7. Skill in evaluating the output of computer tools and adjusting for program conditions.
  
8. Skill in identifying and analyzing cost-effectiveness relations between all aspects of financial management which are subject to significant and continuing changes over time.
  
9. Ability to evaluate acceptability of a submitted budget requirement.
  
10. Ability to communicate effectively the results of evaluations and analysis.
  
11. Ability to adapt models and techniques to changing program requirements.
  
12. Ability to consider and analyze the intent of financial and program legislation and impacts of financial actions upon the finances of contractors.

----------------

* U.S. Citizenship Required
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance.
* Required to handle and safeguard sensitive and/or classified information in accordance with regulations to reduce potential compromise
* This position has been designated as an acquisition position and is covered by the Acquisition Professional Development Program (APDP).
* The employee must meet or be capable of meeting Defense Acquisition Work Improvement Act (DAWIA) requirements applicable to the duties of the positions.

Job Summary:

**Who are we?**

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, Live Nation Media & Sponsorship and Artist Nation Management. Ticketmaster is the global event ticketing leader with over 465 million tickets sold and more than 12,500 clients in 22 countries. Live Nation Concerts has become the single largest provider of live entertainment in the world producing over 25,500 shows annually for over 3,300 artists in 37 countries. Artist Nation Management is one of the world’s leading artist management companies, representing more than 350 artists. These businesses power Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to deliver music marketing programs across 900 brands enabling advertisers to tap into the 63 million fans Live Nation Entertainment delivers annually through its live event and digital platforms. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

**Who are you?**

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

  

**The Role:**

The successful Finance Analyst will be responsible for the following:

**Responsibilities:**

* Review festival contracts and prepare revenue recognition schedules based on contract terms
* Prepare month-end journal entries related to revenue and variable expenses
* Work closely with festival partners to report sponsorship performance
* Research expense report & invoice coding questions
* Reconcile balance sheet accounts
* Mid-month detailed review of actual expense costs
* Lead monthly team review of activity with brand managers
* Analyze and explain variances between actuals and forecast
Ad hoc special projects as required or as necessary  

**Qualifications:**

* 1-4 years relevant experience preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or related field
* Effective interpersonal and superior customer service skills required
* Self-motivated with ability to thrive in demanding, fast-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Problem solving and analytical skills
* Ability to multi-task, implement new processes, and meet time-critical deadlines
* Strong computer skills with demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel required
* Experience with Oracle, SAP or other large automated accounting system a plus
* Experience with Salesforce or other large CRM tool a plus
Ability to be flexible with hours as workload changes

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Superior Court of Los Angeles County is the largest unified trial court in the United States. The Court’s 582 judicial officers and its dedicated workforce of over 4,600 full-time employees serving across 36 facilities work purposefully and seamlessly to achieve the mission to provide equal access to justice to all of Los Angeles County. At the heart of the Superior Court of Los Angeles County is commitment and collaboration between team members who contribute professional skill sets and meaningful work experiences toward the goal of serving the community at large.

  
  

Accessible career paths, a healthy work-life balance, job stability, and comprehensive total rewards including generous pay and benefits, a robust public sector pension, and Court matched 401K/457 individual savings plans, are just some of the values that the Court offers to every member of its thriving workforce. Plan your future with the Superior Court of Los Angeles County – connect with us today.

  
  

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

The Financial Analyst performs responsible financial, statistical, budgetary, contract, procurement, data, procedural, legislative and organizational analyses in support of Court-wide operations.
